text:
ruth: deploy-bot just flagged the release and paused promotion: staging->prod hold. error shows secret key canonicalization mismatch. can we triage?

deploy-bot: Release 2026-03-20T14:02Z paused by policy 'env-parity-check'. Reason: secret key mismatch (count=1). See logs: `/var/log/deploy/2523456789.log`

sam: ugh, this smells like the keycase normalization we fixed last month. quick check: which key?

lee: deploy log excerpt:```diff
- inference_cache_key: s3://redwood-cache/abc
+ INFERENCE_CACHE_KEY: s3://redwood-cache/abc
```

jordan: that explains it — staging had lowercase key, prod uses uppercase env var. our secret loader normalizes in some codepaths but not all.

maria: I think this happens when dockerfile sets env via `ENV INFERENCE_CACHE_KEY` but k8s secret mounted as `inference_cache_key`. the secret controller didn't apply the normalizer.

ruth: is rollback needed or can we patch during the window? change window ends in 45m.

ops_oncall: if we patch, we need a safe canary: promote to canary prod namespace only, verify requests, then full. rollback is low-cost if we pin previous image.

sam: current release also contains a model pin change (model v2.1.4 -> v2.2.0). if we rollback the image but keep DB migrations, could be messy. prefer to patch secret canonicalization in config map or make runtime accept both keys.

lee: quick mitigation patch: add compatibility env var in deployment: `- name: INFERENCE_CACHE_KEY` and set value from secret `inference_cache_key` via k8s fieldRef/template. minimal change. I can open a hotpatch PR.

jordan: also add a short-lived fallback in runtime: read env var lowercase if uppercase missing. small one-line change:```python
cache_key = os.getenv('INFERENCE_CACHE_KEY') or os.getenv('inference_cache_key')
```

maria: agree — do both for safety. runtime fallback first, then deployment patch. test in canary for 10 minutes.

deploy-bot: Note: release promotion remains paused until manual resume. To resume run `/release resume 2523456789` after approvals.

ruth: action plan: 1) jordan to open 1-line runtime fallback PR (link pls) 2) lee to PR k8s hotpatch for canary 3) sam to hold rollback decision until canary verdict. I'll sign off if canary looks good.

jordan: PR opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4237 — adds fallback read, unit test added.

lee: hotpatch PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/manifests/pull/987 — injects INFERENCE_CACHE_KEY env from secret `inference_cache_key`. canary rollout target=prod-canary.

sam: starting canary promote now to prod-canary. will watch metrics and logs: latency, 5xx, cache hits.

ops_oncall: watching logs. provisional check: cache key resolved, requests hitting s3 prefix ok. no 5xx so far.

ruth: holding until 2523456920 then decide. if stable, I'll resume and note in release notes: "patched secret key canonicalization; added runtime fallback".

maria: small FYI for docs: add a note in release checklist to verify secret key casing for k8s -> infra templates.

sam: canary looks green at +8m. metrics stable, cache hitrate normal.

ruth: OK resuming. /release resume 2523456789 (I'll run once CI finishes on both PRs). final decision: no rollback, hotpatch + fallback, add checklist item. :white_check_mark:
